messages.subject: convergence for variational inference
parts:
hi folks,

sorry for the silence.

i'm about to try out / implement code to monitor convergence for ADVI.

attached is a one-page pdf with my status. any/all thoughts are welcome!

i have a question: is there existing code for running window computations in stan? if not, any suggestions?

cheers,
alp

messages.author: 2a7f346506a3e9ff
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] convergence for variational inference
parts:
I have no idea about the running window computations but my hunch is no. 

Anyway, looks pretty reasonable to me for convergence options.  I suspect the running window will be critical and you'll probably want a looser tolerance than what BFGS uses, but I suspect the specifics of what values to use will become clear once it's implemented and you've tested it on a few problems.

Cheers,
Marcus
